fact: El Watan says ministerial order 1275 lets students convert their end-of-studies project into a startup or a patent.
El Watan reports 673 startups created, 3949 patents registered and 2339 'projet innovant' labels issued between 2022 and July 2026.

COSOB, SGBV and Algerie Clearing announced a waiver of IPO and listing fees on the Croissance segment for certified startups until 2028, and about 2,300 of over 7,800 startups on startup.dz are certified as official startups.
We Are Tech reports a government strategy to scale up the entrepreneurial ecosystem, with President Tebboune's target of 20,000 start-ups in Algeria by 2029.
Authorities reported Algeria had registered 130 start-ups and 1,175 projects labeled as innovative.
